description: OFAC SDN list digital-currency addresses (from the Remarks field 'Digital Currency Address - <CODE> <address>'): list up to 200 entries with currency code, address and sanctioned entity name, optionally filtered by currency or checked for one address. Covers the current SDN.CSV only; the list is not complete for every chain, and a miss is not proof an address is clean. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

address.description: Optional address to check against the list

currency.description: Optional currency code such as XBT, ETH, TRX, USDT

limit.description: How many entries to return, 1 to 200 (default 20)

name: crypto_sanctioned_crypto_wallets
title: Crypto Sanctioned Crypto Wallets
